text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's the end of summer training camp, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've caused you quite a bit of 
worry, haven't I, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal... at the Kobe Shimbun Hai, 
I'll do my best to repay you.

As she smiled like that, she seemed to 
have grown significantly on an emotional 
level over the summer.
